content.text:
Resolved T-2003. 

Summary: Checked pods in the `search` namespace — both catalog-search replicas were in CrashLoopBackOff with liveness-probe "connection refused" messages. Logs showed each pod was partway through loading a 48-shard / 12.4 GiB index (opens the HTTP listener only after loading) when it got SIGTERMed. The liveness probe (initialDelaySeconds=30, period=10, failureThreshold=3) fires before the index finishes loading. Recommended fix in the resolution note: add a startupProbe on /healthz with failureThreshold*periodSeconds covering worst-case load (e.g. 30×10 = 5 min), leaving the liveness probe unchanged, with doc citations.
